Visiting

Pantai Carocok tickets & fees

Pantai Carocok is not automatically free, but the amount of any retribution, the payment method, and exemptions can change. This page helps you separate what is stable from what must be confirmed at the gate.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Overview

Types of charges you may meet

Coastal sites often charge a per-person entry retribution, vehicle parking, and separate rates for activities such as boats or island trips. These are handled differently and are not always bundled into one ticket.

  • Entry retribution: usually per person, sometimes different for local residents and outside visitors.
  • Parking: daily or per-entry, varying by vehicle type.
  • Boats and islands: paid separately to crossing operators, not at the beach gate.

Background

Why we do not list a fixed price

The Pesisir Selatan Regency Government reported a digitalisation of Carocok tourism retribution on 30 March 2026. That report sets a policy direction, without confirming today’s rates or payment methods.

Check at the gate

Ask separately about entry, parking, boats and activities from staff or the official notice board before assuming any cost.

Practical

Preparing a budget

Carry small cash and a digital backup if available. Because payment systems can change, do not rely on a single method.

  • Prepare cash for retribution and parking.
  • Confirm the boat fare before boarding, not after reaching the island.
  • Keep any receipt given, for complaint purposes if needed.

Questions

Before you go

01Is Pantai Carocok paid?+

The beach may apply entry, parking, or separate activity charges. As conditions change, read the notices and ask local staff before assuming free or paid.

02What is the exact ticket price?+

We do not list a fixed price because it can change and depends on the manager’s policy and resident or visitor status. Confirm at the gate on the day of your visit.

03Are children or seniors free?+

Exemption rules vary and change. Ask staff directly on arrival rather than relying on outdated information.

04Can I pay by card or e-wallet?+

The regency report mentions retribution digitalisation, but whether a machine or code is available today is unverified. Carry cash as the primary option.
